title: 이 순간, 진짜 오래 기억날 것 같아요

story.text: 여행 마지막 밤, 규현은 낡은 사진 몇 장을 꺼내 테이블에 늘어놓았다. "이거 봐요, 우리 처음 만났을 때 사진이에요."
story.reading: yeo-haeng ma-ji-mak bam, gyu-hyeon-eun nalg-eun sa-jin myeot jang-eul kkeon-nae te-i-beul-e neul-eo-noh-at-da. "i-geo bwa-yo, u-ri cheo-eum man-nass-eul ttae sa-jin-i-e-yo."
story.en: On the last night of the trip, Kyuhyun pulled out a few old photos and laid them across the table. "Look at this, it's a picture from when we first met."

story.text: 사진 속에는 앳된 얼굴의 우리 둘이 서툴게 웃고 있었다. "우와, 이때 진짜 어리다." 나는 웃음을 참지 못했다.
story.reading: sa-jin sog-e-neun aet-doen eol-gul-ui u-ri dul-i seo-tul-ge us-go iss-eot-da. "u-wa, i-ttae jin-jja eo-ri-da." na-neun us-eum-eul cham-ji mot-haet-da.
story.en: In the photo, the two of us with our young, baby faces were smiling awkwardly. "Wow, we look so young here." I couldn't hold back my laughter.

story.text: "그때 아가씨가 길 잃어서 헤매던 거, 아직도 생생하게 기억나요." 그가 사진 한 장을 손끝으로 톡톡 두드리며 말했다.
story.reading: "geu-ttae a-ga-ssi-ga gil ilh-eo-seo he-mae-deon geo, a-jik-do saeng-saeng-ha-ge gi-eok-na-yo." geu-ga sa-jin han jang-eul son-kkeut-eu-ro tok-tok du-deu-ri-myeo mal-haet-da.
story.en: "I still remember so vividly how you got lost and wandered around back then." He tapped a photo lightly with his fingertip as he spoke.

story.text: 하나씩 사진을 넘길 때마다 잊고 지냈던 추억들이 하나둘 되살아났다. 함께 걸었던 골목, 함께 웃었던 순간들.
story.reading: ha-na-ssik sa-jin-eul neom-gil ttae-ma-da it-go ji-naet-deon chu-eok-deul-i ha-na-dul doe-sal-a-nat-da. ham-kke geol-eot-deon gol-mok, ham-kke us-eot-deon sun-gan-deul.
story.en: With every photo I flipped through, memories I'd forgotten came back to life one by one — the alleys we'd walked together, the moments we'd laughed together.

story.text: "이 여행, 저한테는 진짜 소중한 시간이었어요." 내가 진심을 담아 말하자 규현이 잠시 말을 잃었다.
story.reading: "i yeo-haeng, jeo-han-te-neun jin-jja so-jung-han si-gan-i-eot-eo-yo." nae-ga jin-sim-eul dam-a mal-ha-ja gyu-hyeon-i jam-si mal-eul ilh-eot-da.
story.en: "This trip was such a precious time for me, really." I said it with all sincerity, and Kyuhyun fell silent for a moment.

story.text: "저도요. 아가씨 없는 서울은 좀 심심할 것 같은데." 그는 애써 장난스럽게 말했지만, 목소리 끝이 살짝 떨렸다.
story.reading: "jeo-do-yo. a-ga-ssi eop-neun seo-ul-eun jom sim-sim-hal geot gat-eun-de." geu-neun ae-sseo jang-nan-seu-reop-ge mal-haet-ji-man, mok-so-ri kkeut-i sal-jjak tteol-lyeot-da.
story.en: "Me too. Seoul's gonna be kind of boring without you around." He tried to say it playfully, but the end of his voice trembled just a little.

story.text: "돌아가서도 이 순간들, 절대 못 잊을 것 같아요." 나는 눈시울이 붉어지는 걸 애써 감췄다. "저도 아가씨 그리워할 거예요. 이 능글맞은 놈이."
story.reading: "dol-a-ga-seo-do i sun-gan-deul, jeol-dae mot ij-eul geot gat-a-yo." na-neun nun-si-ul-i bulg-eo-ji-neun geol ae-sseo gam-chwot-da. "jeo-do a-ga-ssi geu-ri-wo-hal geo-ye-yo. i neung-geul-maj-eun nom-i."
story.en: "Even after I go back, I don't think I'll ever be able to forget these moments." I tried hard to hide my welling eyes. "I'll miss you too, miss. You smooth-talking rascal."

story.text: 우리는 그날 밤, 낡은 사진 한 장 한 장에 담긴 지난 시간들을 다시 한번 마음에 새겼다. 잊지 못할 추억이 하나 더 쌓이는 순간이었다.
story.reading: u-ri-neun geu-nal bam, nalg-eun sa-jin han jang han jang-e dam-gin ji-nan si-gan-deul-eul da-si han-beon ma-eum-e sae-gyeot-da. it-ji mot-hal chu-eok-i ha-na deo ssah-i-neun sun-gan-i-eot-da.
story.en: That night, we etched the memories held in each old photograph back into our hearts once more. It was the moment one more unforgettable memory was added to the pile.

words.example_en: We made a lot of good memories.
I miss my friends a lot.
You're a truly precious person to me.
I'll never be able to forget that day.

sentences.en: I'll never be able to forget today.
